text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH1013, Large Dragonfly Door Knocker in Nickel Silver

Sprung from the artistic mind of Michael Healy, the Large Nickel Silver Dragonfly Door Knocker is a beautiful statement piece for your front door. This over-sized door knocker is 8-1/2 inches wide and 6-1/2 inches tall with 7/8 inch mounting centers. Dragonflies have long been symbolic of love and new beginnings, making this Nickel Silver Dragonfly Door Knocker the perfect finishing touch on first family homes. The dragonfly in flight door knocker is made from sandcast brass and finished in nickel silver which is a unique finish to Michael Healy Designs. It is created by combining polished nickel with satin highlights that accent this front door knocker's details for a contemporary look.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Available in 3 finishes:
Nickel Silver Polished Brass and Bronze Oiled Bronze

Features and Specifications of the Dragonfly Front Door Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Nickel Sliver
  • Height: 6-1/2
  • Width: 8-1/2"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 7/8"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-3/4"
  • Mounting: Surface Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
